rationales.explanation: Charles sees an opportunity if the company can articulate a credible strategy for capturing the available consumer.

rationales.quote: It's got to work for you.
rationales.explanation: He identifies individualized fit as an essential characteristic of a bra product.

rationales.quote: I'm going for the lowest common denominator, consistent price.
rationales.explanation: Charles believes consumers may accept a poor experience and choose a reliable low price rather than seek a better product, weakening the urgency of the problem.

rationales.quote: I was impressed by your thoughtfulness about the problem.
rationales.explanation: He positively assesses the founders' thoughtful analysis of the customer problem.

rationales.quote: I don’t quite know that we see the opportunity the same way, so it’s not quite right for me.
rationales.explanation: Charles declines because he does not feel aligned with the founders' vision for the brand and opportunity.

rationales.quote: every company has that same narrative, and none of them can seem to chip through.
rationales.explanation: He sees the dominant incumbent and repeated failure of similar companies as evidence that the market is difficult to disrupt.

reversals stay original_pitch. Do not mix retrospective opinions into original-pitch scoring.

merely any question. decision_link supports_in/out ONLY if the target links the rationale to the commitment/refusal.

turn index exactly once, even when it contains no rationale. An empty rationale list is valid if none was expressed.
